group.title: A quotation revision
group.passage:
Woman: Your quotation assumes one thousand units a month. Our forecast is only six hundred units per month for the first quarter.
Man: I can revise the unit price for that volume. Will you still use the same enclosure and packaging?
Woman: The enclosure is unchanged. Please pack the units in plain boxes, with nothing printed on them. Show the packaging cost separately.
Man: Certainly. I will email a revised quotation by tomorrow afternoon.
group.passageZh:
女：你們的報價假設每月一千台。我們預估第一季每月只有六百台。
男：我可以依那個數量修改單價。外殼和包裝仍使用相同的嗎？
女：外殼不變。請用無印刷紙箱裝這批產品。請把包裝費用分開列出。
男：當然。我最遲會在明天下午寄出修訂報價。
